Holiday Tree Luminaries

Description
Get creative with clay at this beginner-friendly pottery class! Participants will create a three-dimensional Christmas tree designed to glow with the light of a candle, making it a festive addition to your holiday décor. No prior clay experience is necessary, making this a great opportunity to try something new and create a seasonal piece of your own. Finished projects will be ready for pick up the following week. The class will take place on Saturday, November 7th, from 9–11 AM and is open to ages 16 and older. The cost is $40 per person. For more information, visit https://macniderart.org/events-calendar/

Charles H. MacNider Art Museum
